problem_type: Input acknowledgment coupled to operation completion
symptom: A submitted draft remains blocked until a tool approval or model turn completes even though its input is already durable.
direct_cause: The host's single prompt await acknowledged only after the entire pi operation settled.
class_root: The application does not expose the SDK's durable admission boundary separately from operation settlement.
internal_only_reason: Installed pi 0.85.1 public accept and drive APIs expose distinct phases of the same operation; the test observes public run_start and run_end events without replacing execution.
invariants: onAccepted runs exactly once after the input is durable and before tool approval completes.
The execute promise still settles the same pi operation and never starts a second run.
generality_proof: A real loopback turn reaches an actual pending approval after its durable input ACK; public run IDs prove admission and final completion belong to one operation.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Expose public pi admission while retaining ownership of its drive promise.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The callback sees the persisted user message and fires before the approval is answered.
The same returned execute promise remains pending during approval; public start/end IDs match exactly once.

recurrence.reason: Every slow turn or pending approval can delay operation completion after input has been accepted.
same_class_scan: Inspected the public pi OperationRequest, accept and drive signatures.
Compared Host prompt implementation at HEAD with the current accept/drive path using an isolated compiled copy.

prevention.invariant: Durable admission ACK and final settlement remain distinct observations of one pi operation.
prevention.failure_mode: Rejected admission does not acknowledge input; execution failure still rejects its operation promise.
prevention.strategy: Call the SDK accept API, invoke onAccepted, then drive its returned operationId to settlement.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace the monolithic prompt await in the existing host; no second runner or acknowledgment timer exists.

dependency_lifecycle.target: A supported pi version preserving durable admission and operationId-driven execution.
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The public SDK provides both boundaries; Nomi only forwards their lifecycle meaning.
exit_criteria: Run the one-operation admission/approval fixture when pi changes accept or drive semantics.

residual_risks: Renderer composer acknowledgment is exercised separately through the parent IPC/UI tests.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The host owns the SDK operation and is the first application boundary that can acknowledge durable admission honestly.
